title: UniBRep: Learning Unified Geometry and Topology for Image-conditioned B-Rep Generation
abstract: Generating a boundary representation (B-rep) conditioned on a single image requires faithful reconstruction of geometry, valid topology, and support for complex shapes. We present UniBRep, a geometry-first framework that adapts a pretrained image-to-3D model to generate a feature mesh as a unified intermediate representation. Its surface provides a geometric scaffold, while spatially aligned learned features encode face-separation cues for topology recovery. Dual decoder branches generate the geometry and face-separation features; a geometry- and feature-guided construction pipeline then fits parametric surfaces, recovers boundary curves and connectivity, and assembles an explicit B-rep using a CAD kernel. Recovering topology from mesh regions avoids predefined architectural face-count limits, allowing face count to scale with shape complexity. On the standard DeepCAD benchmark, UniBRep produces valid B-reps for 80.49\% of inputs and reduces face Chamfer distance from 0.1096 to 0.0345 relative to CADDreamer. In a matched comparison, UniBRep also outperforms the HoLa public demo across all reported metrics. Further evaluations demonstrate scalability to high-complexity shapes beyond the standard 30-face range, generalization to objects outside the CAD training distribution, and qualitative transfer to real photographs.

analysis.ideaZh: UniBRep 将 TRELLIS 适配为 geometry + face-separation feature mesh，再按几何/特征分区、拟合曲面、沿 mesh 边界恢复 trim/topology 并用 OpenCascade 装配。作者报告 DeepCAD valid single solids80.49%、face CD0.0345，值得深读 editable CAD recovery；31+faces validity 仅 37.57%，且几何指标仅 valid outputs，HoLa 对照是 public demo 而非已复现论文结果。
analysis.motivationZh: 单图生成 B-rep 同时需要连续表面与合法共享边界，现有固定 face-count 表示难覆盖复杂形状；论文希望借助 mesh geometry 与 face cues 恢复 CAD 拓扑。
analysis.methodZh: 最终目标是从单图忠实恢复 CAD geometry/topology，归 Reconstruction 并有独立 face segmentation 验证。Geometry branch 先训练并冻结，8Dfeature branch 以 GTface nearest-neighborlabels 和 pull/pushloss 训练；features 只细分 primitive fitting 失败的 regions。Boundary 从 meshtrace 而非 surfaceintersection，cubicB-splines 共享 endpoints 再 projectp-curves 并 sew/heal。Broadprior 提供 plausiblegeometry，BRepvalidity 来自后续 kernelchecks，不恢复 designhistory/constraints 或制造工艺。
methodFlow: DeepCAD tessellation 保留 GTface 对应，rank32 LoRA 适配 TRELLIS SS/SLat generators
Rank16geometrydecoder 生成 256³FlexiCubes surface 后冻结，featuredecoder 学习 8Dface-instanceembeddings
几何 adjacency/normal/boundary regiongrowing 后依次 RANSAC fit 五种 analyticprimitives
仅 fit 失败 regions 作 featuremeanshift+connected components 并重 fit，剩余 FlattenAnything/B-splinefallback
Trace 共享 mesh 边界，cubicB-spline 采样并共享 endpoints 恢复 FE/EV 拓扑
Project 每 facep-curves，OpenCascade sewing/healing；单 SOLID/wire/edge/tessellationchecks 筛 validoutputs
analysis.experimentsZh:
实验设置：DeepCAD64,049train/4,466val/2,605test，standard2424 为 7–30faces，181 为 31+；HoLa818 随机 object/viewpairs 无 outputfilter，BrepGen40OODfurniture，realphotos 仅 qual。SS4A6000×4days，SLat2×3days，decoders2×5days；oneoutput/postprocess perinput，strictOCCsolidchecks/tessellation20stimeout。
作者报告 standardfaceCD.0345、FEFscore.812、valid80.49%；CADDreamer.1096/.384/18.28%compoundaccept。（Table 1, p. 5）
作者报告 818subsetvalid81.30%vsHoLademo70.66%；HoLaprotocolpublished86.37%/faceCD.0101 不可直接比较。（Table 1, p. 5; Table 6, p. 14）
作者报告 31+valid37.57%、40OODfurniture72.5%；A5000end-to-end3.88min，其中 meshgen.17min/parameterization2.07min。（Sec. 5, pp. 7–8）
比较范围：CADDreamer 不同输入/compoundcriterion；HoLapublicdemo 不复现其 paper 且 camera/preproc/evaluation 差异未知；NVDNet/Point2CAD 读 oursgeneratedgeometry/segmentation 且只 paramsurfaces，无 validratio。主要 DeepCAD 和小 40OOD，metricsconditionvalidsets，realphotos 无 GT 或 systematicquality。
消融与诊断：GeometryFT47.65→62.50valid，RGBfeatures74.75、contrastive80.49；samegeneratedgeometryfaceFscore 控制；200caseparameterperturbationsvalid73.5–81，best5postprocess 不能提高 validcount。
analysis.insightZh: Featuremesh 作为 broadimage-to-3Dprior 与 explicitCADtopology 的统一 interface，解耦 geometry 和 facefeatures 并用 meshboundaries 减 surface-intersectionerror。HPNet-styleembedding、RANSAC 与 OCC 均已有，主要价值在 representation/pipelinecoupling 和 controlledpreservation 证据。Variablefacecount 无 architecturalcap 不等于 unbounded 有效 complexity。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: Single-imagefaithfulCAD/BRep recovery 对 editable assets 和 generativeCADtoolchain 有直接 transfer，满足 selectiveReconstruction；face-instancefeaturefield 有 samegeometry 独立 segmentation 指标，次归 3DSegmentation。Fabricationconstraints/manufacturinginstructions 未验证，未归 Fabrication。
analysis.evidenceZh:
Dualdecoder 顺序训练、geometry 冻结后学 facefeatures，featurelabels 来自 GTface nearestneighbor transfer。（Fig. 2, Sec. 3.1/3.2, Eqs. 1–7, pp. 3–4; Appendix A, p. 13；NNlabeltransfer 在 geometryerror 处会错；feature 不是完整 BRepconnectivity 直接编码。）
几何 fit 失败才用 feature 分区，meshboundarytrace+OCCtolerancehealing 构造 solid。（Fig. 3, Sec. 3.3, pp. 4–5; Appendix A, pp. 13–14；Heuristicthresholds/planarfallback/1000-stepparameterization 与 0.1maxheal tolerance 影响精确性。）
作者报告 standardvalid80.49%，geometry/topology 仅 validoutputs 平均；baselineinputs 和 acceptance 不同。（Table 1, Sec. 4.1/4.3, pp. 5–6；CADDreamer GTorthonormalmap、compounds，UniRGB/singlesolid；HoLaRGB+edgeoverlay/demo，不做全结果 same-protocolSOTA 声明。）
Samegeometry face segmentationFscore.783vsNVDNet.690、geometrypreservationmeshCD.0319→BRep.0345。（Sec. 5.1, Tables 2–3, p. 7；Facefeatures 与 geometryFT 各有消融；preservation 比较基于各自 acceptedcases 非 pairedintersection。）
Complexity 与 OOD 有量化，但 31+valid37.57%，freeform/NURBSheavy 仍未测。（Table 4, Sec. 5.2/6, p. 8; Figs. 6–10, pp. 9–10；p8 又写 80.5%fail，与 80.49%valid 及 0.5+4+14.9%failure 分解矛盾，按多张 table 一致 validity 并明确需作者修正文句。）
analysis.caveatZh:
Singleimagehiddengeometry/topologyambiguous，errors 沿 generation/segmentation/fit/assembly 传播。
31+facesvalidity 下降；broaderfreeform/NURBS-heavyuntested。
支持 CADoperations 但不恢复 designhistory/parametricconstraints。
Noarchitecturalfacecap 不保证无限 complexity，fixedgrid/fit/mean-shift/parameterization 成本仍限制。
Geometry/topology 仅 validoutputs 可 selectionbias；各方法 validsets/inputs/acceptance 不完全可比。
OCChealingprecision.01/max.1 在单位 boundingcube 中非精密公差保证；validsolid 不是 manufacturing-ready 验证。
p8failure 句 80.5%与 table 冲突，不能将其作为真实 failurerate；code/weights 尚未确认发布。
